fusions.name: Pile On
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away and slams it for 15 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Hurled Packmate
fusions.desc: Throws a rat at the first enemy in its path. It bites for 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Draw the Brute Off
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckle Tally
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
